column2: [intro]
In this world, I’ve searched every nook,
For what makes me unique, a divine hook,
I’ve looked around, but I’m no detective,
In the end, it’s my style that’s so effective.
It’s my look that gives me pep,
My madness, my greatest asset, oh yes,
What shapes my identity?
It’s my difference that clearly shines for me.
Everyone follows fashion like soldiers in line,
But I dance in my polka-dot socks, just fine!
In my life, I’m a brand new architect,
Building my identity with colors, perfect and direct.
It’s my look that gives me pep,
My madness, my greatest asset, oh yes,
What shapes my identity?
It’s my difference that clearly shines for me.
